proposal.summary: redis-py before 4.5.3 can leave a connection open after canceling an async Redis command and may send response data to the client of an unrelated request in an off-by-one manner.

AV.quote: leaves a connection open after canceling an async Redis command

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request full technical details and a reproduction case (steps, async cancellation timing, and impacted redis-py versions) and ask the reporter to confirm whether authentication or network isolation mitigations affect exposure.

evidence_quotes.quote: redis-py before 4.5.3 leaves a connection open after canceling an async Redis command at an inopportune time, and can send response data to the client of an unrelated request in an off-by-one manner.
4.3.6, 4.4.3, and 4.5.3 were released (changing the behavior for pipeline operations)
please see CVE-2023-28859 about addressing data leakage across AsyncIO connections in general.
